cause.what_happened: After running about +101% in 20 sessions (CEO buying at ~$3.85 on 2026-09-14, prior close ~$7.11), the stock fell about 25% by 15:05 ET, almost all of it intraday and on about 0.5x normal dollar volume. No 6-K, F-1 or other SEC filing since 2026-09-16. This reads as a momentum unwind / sell-the-news, not a new adverse fact.

findings.finding: An effective resale F-1 (333-290471, effective 2026-05-29, supplement No. 2 filed 2026-09-01) registers 58,571,199 shares for selling shareholders, so registered non-insider holders can sell into any bounce on 2026-10-07 with the stock still about 40% above where it was before the September run.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The registration is effective now and needs no further filing, so supply is available in the window itself; holders who did not sell into the run-up are under water on part of it after today and can exit into a rebound.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No dated sale by a selling holder found; the CEO, who holds most of the registered shares, has only bought (Form 4s 2026-09-08, 09-10, 09-16) and filed no sale in 12 months. The name's own 10 comparable falls rose next session 7 times, so this overhang has not historically capped a next-day bounce.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has taken today's selling but not the supply that meets a rebound; if it held that supply, the drop would not be on half-normal volume, because sellers would already be finished. Public and private warrants ($11.50 strike) are far out of the money and add nothing.
findings.independence: The Nasdaq insider summary shows no insider sells in 12 months (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/company/YDES/insider-trades?limit=15&type=ALL), which cuts against the largest registered holder being a seller. So this finding is sized small.

outside_window.finding: CEO Ethan Shen bought shares on the open market at ~$3.85 on 2026-09-14 (and filed Form 4s on 09-08 and 09-10). A further dated purchase would put a disclosed buyer under the stock, but none is filed and none is scheduled inside the window.

The going-concern language in the 2026-04-30 20-F and the 2026-05-26 POS AM, with $6.0M of cash at 2025-12-31, implies a future primary raise. No primary shelf or ATM is on file (latest ATM language is from 2025-07-18), so it cannot price tonight.
The EG BioMed merger (MOU January 2026) is expected to close in 2026 subject to definitive agreements. Nothing in the record dates it.
